rationale: Base station is online with uplink_status "ok" and all 5 devices online, yet events never reach the cloud — E-503 "TLS handshake error" is logged repeatedly. The standard L1 fix (verify internet, restart router/base station, DNS to automatic) was performed and did not resolve it. Per the fault-code reference and historical case H-06, persistent E-503 with a TLS handshake error while the base is online indicates a cloud-channel/certificate issue requiring FAE escalation.
